login.title: Welcome!!
login.subtitle: Enter your mobile number to sign in.
login.country_restricted: Available for Myanmar, Thailand, and China numbers.
login.qa_q1: Which phone numbers can I use?
login.qa_a1: Myanmar (+95), Thailand (+66), and China (+86) mobile numbers are supported.
login.qa_q2: I did not receive the OTP.
login.qa_a2: Wait a moment and tap Resend. Check your signal and that the number is correct.
login.qa_q3: Why must I accept Terms & Conditions?
login.qa_a3: You need to agree before we can send an OTP and create your account.
login.qa_q4: Who can I call for help?
login.qa_a4: Use the hotline for your country shown on the login screen.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.body:
By using the CG-NET mobile app, you agree to use our internet services lawfully and keep your account credentials secure.

You are responsible for activity under your account. CG-NET may update these terms to improve service quality, security, and compliance.

We collect only the information needed to provide connectivity, billing, and support. Your data is handled according to our privacy practices.

Service availability depends on network coverage and plan status. For support, contact CG-NET Help from the app anytime.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.empty_body: You'll see announcements and notifications here.
inbox.msg1_body: Network maintenance tonight 01:00–03:00. Short interruptions may occur during this window.
inbox.msg1_detail:
We will perform scheduled network maintenance tonight from 01:00 to 03:00.

During this window you may notice short interruptions or slower speeds. Voice and data services will recover automatically after the work is complete.

Affected areas: Yangon and surrounding townships.
No action is required on your side.

Thank you for your patience while we improve network reliability.
inbox.msg2_body: Upgrade this month and get bonus points on eligible higher-speed plans.
inbox.msg2_detail:
Upgrade your plan this month and receive bonus loyalty points.

Offer highlights:
• Extra points when you move to a higher speed tier
• Points credited within 48 hours after activation
• Valid for residential accounts only

Open Packages in the app to compare plans and buy now. This promotion ends at the end of the month.
inbox.msg3_body: Expanded fiber coverage in Yangon downtown. Check if your street is now available.
inbox.msg3_detail:
CG Net has expanded fiber coverage across more blocks in downtown Yangon.

If you previously could not get installation at your address, please try again or contact Support with your location details.

New coverage includes selected streets near Sule, Botahtaung, and Pazundaung. Availability still depends on building access and final survey.
inbox.msg4_body: Your March invoice is available in the app. Please pay before the due date.
inbox.msg4_detail:
Your March invoice is ready to view.

You can check the amount due, billing period, and payment history from the Check bill / Pay bill services on Home.

Please pay before the due date to avoid service interruption. If you already paid, allow up to one business day for the status to update.
inbox.msg5_body: Thanks for joining. Explore packages, bind your account, and open Support anytime.
inbox.msg5_detail:
Welcome to CG Net!

Here is how to get started:
1. Bind your broadband account from Home if you already have a line.
2. Browse Packages for special data offers.
3. Use Top up and Transfer for points, and open Support when you need help.

You can change language anytime from Account → Language. We are glad to have you connected with us.
inbox.msg6_body: Limited-time discount on selected 6-month plans during the festival campaign.
inbox.msg6_detail:
Celebrate with a limited-time discount on selected 6-month plans.

Save on prepaid packages while the festival offer is active. Discounts apply automatically at checkout for eligible plans.

Terms:
• One promotional purchase per account
• Cannot be combined with other coupons
• Offer may end without prior notice when stock or campaign ends

Visit Packages → See all to review eligible plans and buy now.
